desc:
🎯 Welcome to AWP Arena!

Crossbow and NUKE TOWN Update!! 

How to Play:
🔫 Battle in Free For All and other game modes
🏆 Play Casual or Ranked
📈 Rank up and face better players
🎨 Collect rare Sniper Skins
🪙 Sell skins to earn Trade Tokens
🤝 Use Tokens to buy skins on the market
✨ Combine Snipers to upgrade their rarity
🥇 Reach the Top 150 for special rewards and exclusive skins  

Controls:
🖥️ PC Controls:
Shoot — M1
Aim — M2
Slide — C / Ctrl  

🎮 Controller:
Shoot — R2
Aim — L2
Slide — B / ○  

📱 Mobile Controls:
On-screen buttons

🔥 Improve your aim, climb the leaderboards, and become one of the best snipers in AWP Arena!
👍 Leave a like for more Updates!
🐛 Found a bug? Report it in the group or Community Server for rewards!
